title: Look Before You Leap: An Exploratory Study of Uncertainty Analysis for Large Language Models
review_status: full-text audit complete; code-generation datasets, uncertainty estimators, AUC results, partial-error analysis, distance-function caveats, and publication chronology checked
sections_checked: Sections IV-B to IV-C benchmark data and metrics
Sections V-C to V-D code-generation uncertainty results and limitations
Discussion of partial correctness and distance functions
venue_year_verified: Initial arXiv submission 2023-07-16; arXiv v4 dated 2025-01-05; IEEE Transactions on Software Engineering 51(2), 413-429 (2025), DOI 10.1109/TSE.2024.3519464
evidence_note: Tests uncertainty ranking against complete correctness on HumanEval/MBPP, not probability calibration. Sample-based methods generally lead, but AUC varies across model/dataset; partial errors are harder (40.4% of GPT-3.5 MBPP errors passed at least one test vs 27.3% GPT-4o and 32.4% GPT-4o mini). CodeBLEU often beats embedding cosine for uncertainty distance but can overreact to harmless identifier changes. Corpus stratum is based on initial arXiv year; journal publication followed in 2025.

title: Astraios: Parameter-Efficient Instruction Tuning Code Large Language Models
review_status: full-text audit complete; model/tuning grid, code-generation/repair, robustness and security endpoints, and scale-dependent conclusions checked
sections_checked: Conclusions and limits of automated security scenarios
venue_year_verified: arXiv v1 dated 2024-01-01; venue not independently checked
evidence_note: 28 OctoCoder checkpoints: four model sizes (1B/3B/7B/16B), six PEFT methods plus full fine-tuning. FFT generally has best task scores; LoRA often yields best cost/performance. Reports lower robustness/security at larger scale in tested settings. AATK security results narrow to 40 automatically testable scenarios; does not evaluate uncertainty-based risk ranking.

title: Exploring the Capabilities of LLMs for Code Change Related Tasks
review_status: full-text audit complete; three task/dataset designs, input example and model-size effects, PEFT results, metric boundaries, and human-evaluation scope checked
sections_checked: Sections 2.1-2.6 task datasets, metrics, and settings
Appendix A and human evaluation scope
venue_year_verified: arXiv v1 dated 2024-07-03; venue not independently checked
evidence_note: Studies code-review generation, commit-message generation, and just-in-time comment update; uses BLEU/B-Norm/GLEU and exact-comment accuracy, with human review only for commit messages. In-context example gains are non-monotonic; LoRA beats prefix tuning in tested comparisons; CCT5 is a strong code-change-specialized baseline. These measures do not directly score defect detection, test-passing fixes, or introduced vulnerabilities.
